prepare.response: OrchestrationContractView; 201 first save, 200 exact replay, 409 conflicting key or stale inputs

approve.response: OrchestrationContractView; 409 on changed selection or context

contract.digest: 64 lowercase hex characters, prepared input only

input.approvals: exact private Design and definition approval selection
input.route: resolved public ProjectRunRoute; local Docker is the empty executionLocation in the existing run convention; no credentials

controls.authorityPolicyDigest: sha256; digest is the version for the legacy unnumbered management policy
controls.executionLimits: nonsecret saved budget, memory, CPU, concurrency and cloud/public permission fields
controls.teamRevision: integer when scoped to a team
controls.memberRevision: integer when scoped to a team
controls.projectGrantRevision: integer when scoped to a team

standards.revision: exact immutable library revision or Design revision
standards.digest: exact imported library digest or approved freeform-context digest
standards.contentDigest: sha256 of the bounded selected control/assessment fields without document quote text
standards.requirements: for a team library, complete bounded imported control IDs, requirement/applicability/evidence fields, assessed statuses/notes and exact retained source references; selected document quotes are untrusted data. No unknown workbook columns, original bytes or credentials. A projection over 64 KiB refuses preparation instead of truncating.

decisionPolicy.humanInput: outside saved authority, contradictory intent, or missing evidence

legacy: Runs without orchestrationContract remain readable and explicitly unassessed. Preparation and approval never start an agent or grant spending or deployment authority.
